textHelp.help1: The Catalog manager extension allows you to manage STAC catalogs: browse collections and items, apply spatial, temporal and advanced filters, display footprints and images on the map, and download the results.
textHelp.help2: This extension is customizable via parameters, so the extension can change from one viewer to another.
textHelp.help3: Some catalogs require authentication. When selected, a login dialog is shown where you can sign in with username and password or as a public user:
textHelp.help4: From the Catalogs section you choose the STAC catalog you want to work with:
textHelp.help5: The temporal filter restricts the search to a date and time range. You can set the dates manually or use the shortcuts (last 30 days, 3 months or last year) and apply the indicated range:
textHelp.help6: The spatial filter limits the results to a geographic area. It allows filtering by the current map view, by a drawn extent or by a previously drawn reference geometry:
textHelp.help7: The Collections section lists the available collections of the catalog. Selecting one or more queries their items according to the applied filters:
textHelp.help8: The advanced STAC filter allows refining the search over the queryable properties of the items in a collection.
textHelp.help9: In the Assistant tab the filter expression is built by selecting queryable fields and operators, and it can be applied or cleared from the dialog itself:
textHelp.help10: In the Manual query tab you can enter a STAC query directly in JSON format:
textHelp.help11: The Results tab shows the items found. You can paginate, select, view metadata, display the footprint on the map and start individual or bulk downloads (depending on the catalog):
textHelp.help12: Expanding an item lists its associated images, with actions to preview them on the map or download them:
textHelp.help13: The information relevant to the extension and its possible parameterization is documented in
textHelp.help14: The example of use of its parameters can be checked in
